paraphrase: For an existing x at the selected world, if x is in y in the supplied Categories relation, then y exists there and directly supports x. An explicit open premise, not attributed to Aristotle: Categories I.2 says that what is in a subject cannot be apart from it, which is weaker than having it as a direct existing supporter.
